districts.name: Willow Quay
districts.customers: Ferry workers, evening walkers and families shop beside the quiet water.

stalls.name: Chestnut Brazier
stalls.habit: Lin saves the warmest paper cone for the last ferry worker.
stalls.hire: Ask Lin to tend the brazier
stalls.gossip: Lin says the ferries ran late, so she kept the coals warm.
stalls.next: Suri brings the Ribbon Cart once ten braziers are roasting.

stalls.name: Ribbon Cart
stalls.habit: Suri ties each bow twice, then lets the breeze try it.
stalls.hire: Ask Suri to take the cart
stalls.gossip: Suri says a loose ribbon found its way home on the breeze.
stalls.next: Tao brings the Soup Kettle once ten ribbon carts are tying.

stalls.name: Soup Kettle
stalls.habit: Tao warms each empty bowl before the soup goes in.
stalls.hire: Ask Tao to tend the kettle
stalls.gossip: Tao says the bowl returned first, and its owner stayed to talk.
stalls.next: Neri brings the Kite Bench once ten kettles are simmering.

stalls.name: Kite Bench
stalls.habit: Neri holds every kite up to the lamplight before tying its tail.
stalls.hire: Ask Neri to take the bench
stalls.gossip: Neri says the smallest kite flew higher than anyone expected.
stalls.next: Asha brings the Flower Barrow once ten kite benches are folding.

stalls.name: Flower Barrow
stalls.habit: Asha turns the flowers toward the water while she fills their jars.
stalls.hire: Ask Asha to take the barrow
stalls.gossip: Asha says someone brought an empty jar back with a thank-you note.
stalls.next: Fen brings the Music Corner once ten flower barrows are wrapping.

stalls.name: Music Corner
stalls.habit: Fen leaves a quiet space between tunes for the ferries to answer.
stalls.hire: Ask Fen to take the corner
stalls.gossip: Fen says a ferry bell joined the tune at just the right moment.

districts.name: Cedar Steps
districts.customers: Hilltop neighbours, garden porters and late-shift potters stop beneath the cedar trees.

stalls.name: Sesame Griddle
stalls.habit: Yan turns the little cakes until both sides catch the evening light.
stalls.hire: Ask Yan to tend the griddle
stalls.gossip: Yan says a porter followed the warm sesame smell all the way uphill.
stalls.next: Rui brings the Ink Table once ten griddles are warming.

stalls.name: Ink Table
stalls.habit: Rui tests each brush with a tiny leaf in the corner of the paper.
stalls.hire: Ask Rui to take the table
stalls.gossip: Rui says a gardener recognised her own tree in a painted leaf.
stalls.next: Mina brings the Pickle Crock once ten ink tables are brushing.

stalls.name: Pickle Crock
stalls.habit: Mina tucks a clean wooden spoon beside every jar.
stalls.hire: Ask Mina to tend the crock
looks: Bright jars along a stone wall
stalls.gossip: Mina says the late-shift potters always ask for the crispest slices.
stalls.next: Orin brings the Mending Basket once ten pickle crocks are filling.

stalls.name: Mending Basket
stalls.habit: Orin matches each patch by holding it beside the nearest lantern.
stalls.hire: Ask Orin to take the basket
looks: Mended coats on a wooden rail
stalls.gossip: Orin says a familiar coat came back with a new story in its pocket.
stalls.next: Vela brings the Glaze Wheel once ten mending baskets are stitching.

stalls.name: Glaze Wheel
stalls.habit: Vela leaves one small thumbprint underneath every bowl.
stalls.hire: Ask Vela to tend the wheel
stalls.gossip: Vela says the neighbours can find their own bowls by touch.
stalls.next: Jori brings the Shadow Screen once ten glaze wheels are turning.

stalls.name: Shadow Screen
stalls.habit: Jori lets the smallest listener choose which paper bird flies first.
stalls.hire: Ask Jori to take the screen
looks: Bird shadows across the cedar wall
stalls.gossip: Jori says the last paper bird stayed for an encore after the shops closed.
